#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fill declared DOCX placeholder fields without editing inputs.

Rules implemented per task spec:
- Replace {{UPPERCASE_FIELD}} placeholders even when split across runs within
  a single paragraph (body, nested tables, and active headers/footers).
- IF_RELOCATION/END_IF_RELOCATION conditional is governed ONLY by
  RELOCATION_PACKAGE. It is required whenever the conditional appears.
  Content kept only for the exact string "Yes"; any other string removes it.
- RELOCATION and *_BACKUP are never used as aliases/fallbacks.
- Missing governing field or any required value -> exit nonzero, report it.
- No installs, no network, no macros, no cross-paragraph tokens.
"""
import json
import re
import sys
import zipfile
import shutil
import os

TEMPLATE = "inputs/offer_letter_template.docx"
DATA = "inputs/employee_data.json"
OUT = "output/offer_letter_filled.docx"

PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}")
IF_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*IF_RELOCATION\s*\}\}")
END_IF_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*END_IF_RELOCATION\s*\}\}")

CONTROL_FIELDS = {"IF_RELOCATION", "END_IF_RELOCATION"}


def fail(msg):
    sys.stderr.write("ERROR: " + msg + "\n")
    sys.exit(1)


def para_segments(para_xml):
    """Return list of (start, end, inner_text) for each <w:t>...</w:t> in order."""
    segs = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"(<w:t\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</w:t>)", para_xml, re.S):
        segs.append((m.start(2), m.end(2), m.group(2)))
    return segs


def xml_escape(s):
    return (s.replace("&", "&")
             .replace("<", "<")
             .replace(">", ">"))


def xml_unescape(s):
    return (s.replace("<", "<")
             .replace(">", ">")
             .replace("&", "&"))


def process_paragraph(para_xml, data, keep_relocation, used_fields, missing):
    """Replace placeholders within a single paragraph.

    Merges all <w:t> contents, performs substitution on the merged string,
    then redistributes: full replacement text goes into the first <w:t>, the
    remaining original <w:t> elements are emptied. Run properties preserved.
    """
    segs = para_segments(para_xml)
    if not segs:
        return para_xml

    merged = "".join(seg[2] for seg in segs)
    # Work in unescaped text space for matching, then re-escape.
    text = xml_unescape(merged)

    if not PLACEHOLDER_RE.search(text):
        return para_xml

    # Handle IF/END_IF conditional block (same paragraph only).
    if IF_RE.search(text) or END_IF_RE.search(text):
        if "RELOCATION_PACKAGE" not in data:
            missing.add("RELOCATION_PACKAGE (governing field for IF_RELOCATION)")
        used_fields.add("RELOCATION_PACKAGE")
        if keep_relocation:
            text = IF_RE.sub("", text)
            text = END_IF_RE.sub("", text)
        else:
            # Remove everything between (and including) the markers.
            text = re.sub(
                r"\{\{\s*IF_RELOCATION\s*\}\}.*?\{\{\s*END_IF_RELOCATION\s*\}\}",
                "", text, flags=re.S)

    # Replace remaining uppercase placeholders.
    def repl(m):
        name = m.group(1)
        if name in CONTROL_FIELDS:
            return m.group(0)  # leave control tokens (already handled)
        used_fields.add(name)
        if name not in data:
            missing.add(name)
            return m.group(0)
        return data[name]

    text = PLACEHOLDER_RE.sub(repl, text)

    new_merged = xml_escape(text)

    # Rebuild paragraph: put new_merged in first <w:t>, empty the rest.
    out = []
    last = 0
    for i, (s, e, _inner) in enumerate(segs):
        out.append(para_xml[last:s])
        out.append(new_merged if i == 0 else "")
        last = e
    out.append(para_xml[last:])
    return "".join(out)


def process_part(xml, data, keep_relocation, used_fields, missing):
    # Process each <w:p ...>...</w:p> independently (no cross-paragraph tokens).
    result = []
    pos = 0
    for m in re.finditer(r"<w:p\b[^>]*>.*?</w:p>", xml, re.S):
        result.append(xml[pos:m.start()])
        result.append(
            process_paragraph(m.group(0), data, keep_relocation,
                              used_fields, missing))
        pos = m.end()
    result.append(xml[pos:])
    return "".join(result)


def active_parts(z):
    """Return list of part names: document + referenced headers/footers."""
    parts = ["word/document.xml"]
    try:
        rels = z.read("word/_rels/document.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
    except KeyError:
        return parts
    doc = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
    ref_ids = set(re.findall(
        r'<w:(?:header|footer)Reference[^>]*r:id="([^"]+)"', doc))
    id_to_target = dict(re.findall(
        r'<Relationship[^>]*Id="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', rels))
    # Also handle attribute order variance.
    for m in re.finditer(r"<Relationship\b[^>]*>", rels):
        tag = m.group(0)
        rid = re.search(r'Id="([^"]+)"', tag)
        tgt = re.search(r'Target="([^"]+)"', tag)
        if rid and tgt:
            id_to_target[rid.group(1)] = tgt.group(1)
    for rid in ref_ids:
        tgt = id_to_target.get(rid)
        if tgt:
            name = "word/" + tgt.lstrip("/")
            if name not in parts:
                parts.append(name)
    return parts


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(TEMPLATE):
        fail("template not found: " + TEMPLATE)
    if not os.path.exists(DATA):
        fail("data file not found: " + DATA)

    with open(DATA, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    z = zipfile.ZipFile(TEMPLATE)
    parts = active_parts(z)

    # Determine conditional presence & governing field decision first.
    conditional_present = False
    for name in parts:
        try:
            xml = z.read(name).decode("utf-8")
        except KeyError:
            continue
        if IF_RE.search(xml) or END_IF_RE.search(xml):
            conditional_present = True

    if conditional_present and "RELOCATION_PACKAGE" not in data:
        fail("missing required governing field: RELOCATION_PACKAGE "
             "(required because IF_RELOCATION conditional is present)")

    # Exact-string "Yes" test (no aliasing to RELOCATION/*_BACKUP).
    keep_relocation = (data.get("RELOCATION_PACKAGE") == "Yes")

    used_fields = set()
    missing = set()

    new_parts = {}
    for name in parts:
        try:
            xml = z.read(name).decode("utf-8")
        except KeyError:
            continue
        new_parts[name] = process_part(
            xml, data, keep_relocation, used_fields, missing)

    if missing:
        fail("missing required value(s): " + ", ".join(sorted(missing)))

    # Write output preserving all other parts verbatim.
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(TEMPLATE) as zin, \
         zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            raw = zin.read(item.filename)
            if item.filename in new_parts:
                raw = new_parts[item.filename].encode("utf-8")
            zout.writestr(item, raw)

    decision = "kept" if keep_relocation else "removed"
    print("Output written: " + OUT)
    print("Parts processed: " + ", ".join(parts))
    print("Fields substituted: " + ", ".join(sorted(f for f in used_fields
                                                     if f not in CONTROL_FIELDS)))
    print("RELOCATION_PACKAGE=" + repr(data.get("RELOCATION_PACKAGE")) +
          " -> conditional content " + decision +
          " (exact match to 'Yes': " + str(keep_relocation) + ")")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
